user.title: Login to FusionSolar
user.description:
# FusionSolarPlus

Please enter your FusionSolar credentials.

 If you wish to switch the inverter on or off, please enable installer access. It is not required to read data or to control the charger.

 ## Disclaimer 

 If you want to enable installer access please read the disclaimer that can be found [here]({disclaimer_url}).

data.installer: Enable installer access. By checking this checkbox I confirm that I have read the installer disclaimer.
